goal: Run two complete v0.5 browser-account regression rounds and prepare a verified Chrome Web Store ZIP only if both rounds pass

constraints.cleanup: Restore every test-only setting and reversible X action before the round ends
constraints.packageGate: Do not create the final store ZIP unless both browser rounds pass

tasks.task: Run browser-account regression round 1 across master enablement, bubble/position, scope, auto tier, badge, local hide/undo, X mute, X block, options navigation, and responsive/dark interaction states

tasks.task: Repeat the complete strategy and interaction regression independently after restoring the baseline

needsUserAction.action: In chrome://extensions, reload the unpacked MXGA extension from extension/.output/chrome-mv3, then open its settings page and leave that tab open
needsUserAction.reason: The browser controller is blocked from chrome:// and chrome-extension:// pages, so it cannot reload the just-built package or create the settings tab itself; both are required before round 1 can verify the exact build and every strategy control
